methods.comment:
* Returns the {@link LayoutInflater} which should be used when inflating any layouts * from your {@link SpinnerAdapter#getDropDownView(int, View, ViewGroup)}. * *

The instance returned will have a correct theme, meaning that any inflated views * will be created with the same theme.
